text: The last snow melts from the roof tiles one drop at a time.
A boat leaves the harbor before anyone is awake to see it go.
She folds the letter twice before deciding not to send it.
The market empties out and the pigeons take the square.
My grandmother's hands remember a language I never learned.
The train slows for a station no one gets off at.
An orchard planted by a man who never tasted its fruit.
The phone rings twice in an empty house and then stops.
